fusions.name: Wake Pulse
fusions.desc: Pushes a wake out from you that deals 10 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and slows them by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tide
fusions.desc: Rolls a tide into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 water damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Calm Waters
fusions.desc: Healing you receive rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Rest
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
